notes.title: BANKRUPT BAR SIMULATOR 0.9.9.9 💸
notes.content:
Hello fellow progressing people,

for the spoopy season we bring you the most scary stuff we gamedevs had experienced ever: THE UNITY RUNTIME FEE BANKRUPT UPDATE!

[b]UPDATE: [/b]This Update was delayed, because we couldn't make a new sale, because our game was "too cheap", because we never updated our prices and they went below thresholds on all of our games.

Unity wanted to introduce a completely insane runtime fee for every installation of a game ever made with Unity, which would had bankrupt many studios.
To honor this very "interesting" decision, we added a new achievement: [b]BANKRUPT[/b].
Install our game 5 times and you would had cost us more money that we would had made on a sale *

* WAY before that, because of all the fees, but we are going for gross revenue here ^^"

You can read our statement here: 
[url=https://spielmannspiel.com/blog/statement_unity]The state(ment) of Unity
[/url]

A lot of people put videos together about what happened, here is a playlist with [url=https://www.youtube.com/@CallumUpton]Callum Upton[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/@LostRelicGames]Lost Relic Games[/url] who summed it up pretty well.
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tPm_4EvdJD0&list=PLhdPhZjBsEOGFeW23aG2FyXlrc3btm4Xw]PLAYLIST[/url]
[previewyoutube=tPm_4EvdJD0;full][/previewyoutube]

We also added a rudimentary Steam Deck support for the main menu (dev console is still a work in progress), better [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/661230/discussions/1/6929409304782106641/]firehorse error message[/url] and the reviews of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199180927141/recommended/661230/]Miky11 review[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199107264438/recommended/661230/]blueskies9968[/url].
Also added "date" command to the terminal to show what the date is that the PBS receives from the operating system (which for some people seems to be not what they expect under [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/661230/discussions/1/3808406007554315647/]certain circumstances[/url] ^^") 

Happy progressing <3

The SpielmannSpiel Team

notes.title: I'm making a note here: HUGE PROGRESS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658072/f472057f6e232c53e90e791b85c164a7815e78f1.png[/img]

Hello progressing people,

I hope you are good today. Here comes the BIGGEST Progress Bar Simulator update so far for you, the [b]Halloween update[/b].
But wait what? An Update for a 99 cent game?
REALLY? The developers must be nuts, this won't pay off in ANY way!
But yes, this is a completely free content update with wanted features, more amazing indie-bars, improvements all over the place and did I mention 5, YES !5! new Progress Bars!
Insane, isn't it? But you, the players made it possible. Giving me the motivation and resources to work even further on this fun little project you all seem to enjoy playing as much as I enjoy making it.

I have the honor to announce that we got the loading screen of the amazing strategy building game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/898720/Kubifaktorium/]Kubifaktorium[/url] now available as one of our Progress Bars

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/898720/Kubifaktorium/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658072/24b2b4b49d36c4bdd605e6350c5617a01fd1dc5d.png[/img][/url]

And our second new indie-bar is the amazing strategy building game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/821250/Flotsam/]Flotsam[/url].

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/821250/Flotsam/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658072/fb21b760e92f2cd62a67cf796aed6accba6a5494.png[/img]
[/url]

And HUGE THANKS to Loren Lemcke, who made [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/532190/Super_Blood_Hockey/]Super Blood Hockey[/url], for the permission to use the TV screen from the loading screen as our new screen border. I was looking for one and thought "This is PERFECT" so I kindly asked for the permission and got it. THANK YOU SO MUCH 💖

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/532190/Super_Blood_Hockey/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34658072/1ba3228074e59c688b186165ef7a6d2a5ab43342.jpg[/img][/url]

Last but not least comes the Changelog nobody reads with a little more details on what changed.

[list]
[*] new Bar: Kubifaktorium
[*] new Bar: Flotsam
[*] new Bar: minix installer
[*] new Bar: Borland C++ 5.02
[*] new Bar: @year_progress
[*] 2 all new achievements
[*] optional screen border
[*] screensaver
[*] seasoned screensaver
[*] sound can now be muted
[*] steam API update
[*] engine update
[/list]

- happy progressing 🖖

notes.title: 🎉Rise_to_Progress_RELEASE_update_final2.doc 🎉
notes.content:
Good news, everyone!

It should have been here from day 1, but Valve was really concerned about the copyright of this Progress Bar, so we launched without it.
But now IT IS BACK!
We proudly present the [url=store.steampowered.com/app/328080/Rise_to_Ruins?src=pbsUpdate]Rise to Ruins[/url] loading screen!
Ray (the really awesome developer of Rise to Ruins) gave us the permission to use his logo and loading screen in our fun little game and we are proud to finally bring it to you ːghsmileː

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34658072/e6d6aea7a41d90c19db5d3eed97bc42c05940081.png[/img]

Also we updated the RUN.bar, so there is now a Progress Bar counter, that when we Update and add new Progress Bars the speedrun times stay competitive.
Sadly your old record will be overwritten when there is a new Bar in town, but hey, there is now at least one new Progress bar to encounter ːghsmileː

- happy progressing

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34658072/da4fce8bcf77326f60332317e05a0d9e289bd3ff.png[/img]

notes.title: ITS RELEASE DAY 🎉 (kinda) 🎉
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I know you are eager to finally make your progress through computer history, but we won't make our release date (at least not on steam).
While the folks at Valve are really helpful, we couldn't resolve all issues in time, but we are sure we will release within the week.

Meanwhile you can buy Progress Bar Simulator on our homepage with a widget, play DRM free now and get a steam key that will work as soon as we get all issues resolved.

Stay tuned!

- SpielmannSpiel
